subject.title: [regression] Bundled MCP config tempDir race still present on openclaw@2026.5.20 (#73244 reopened?)

question: Should maintainers accept the current source and release-diff proof as enough to restore Claude live-session prepared-cleanup ownership now, or require a live current-main repro first?
rationale: The code path now matches the originally fixed tempDir lifecycle bug, but current main also has tests asserting the newer whole-run cleanup owner, so changing it back should be an explicit maintainer call.

options.title: Restore cleanup ownership now
options.body: Treat the source regression from `v2026.6.11` as sufficient proof and patch the live-session cleanup path with focused regression tests.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open behind `needs-live-repro` until someone reproduces the missing `mcp.json` failure on current main or a current package.

options.title: Fold into broader session policy
options.body: Defer this issue to the broader CLI session lifecycle work if maintainers want one coordinated policy change rather than a narrow regression fix.

recommendation.title: Restore cleanup ownership now
recommendation.body: Treat the source regression from `v2026.6.11` as sufficient proof and patch the live-session cleanup path with focused regression tests.
